text: Before a reading is accepted, check each acceptance criterion against Athena's recorded defaults (records/default-expectations, e.g. the changelog default) and its landing and records invariants. Flag any criterion that would fail work a default requires, or would allow an outcome an invariant forbids. Add tests: a criterion that forbids CHANGELOG.md when the changelog default applies is flagged, and a criterion that allows extra commits after the landing commit is flagged.
